body.p: By way of the amendment instructions above, a self-evident clerical error has been corrected in paragraph [0089] of the specification.
Claims 1-16 have been canceled without prejudice or disclaimer to the Applicant's rights under 35 USC §121.
Claims 17-21 have been amended so as to reference an electrospun "nanofiber mat" that finds basis throughout the originally filed specification.

In this regard, claims 22-30 are directed toward the embodiment shown in FIGS. 5A-51 and the description thereof appearing in paragraphs [0068]-[0070] of the originally filed specification. Claims 31-36 on the other hand find basis in certain of the original claims 1-16 (which constitute their own "disclosure").

Applicant hereby elects the invention of Group II drawn to a method of making a flexible electrode. All pending claims 17-36 read on the elected subject matter of Group II and are therefore properly examined together.
As noted above, the claims of Group I directed toward a patentably distinct
invention non-elected for prosecution herein have been canceled without prejudice or disclaimer to the Applicant's rights to file a divisional application with respect to such subject matter.
An early and favorable reply on the merits of elected claims 17-36 is therefore awaited.

The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency, or credit any overpayment, in the fee(s) filed, or asserted to be filed, or which should have been filed herewith (or with any paper hereafter filed in this application by this firm) to our Account No. 14-1140.
